paper.title: Alita: Generalist Agent Enabling Scalable Agentic Reasoning with Minimal Predefinition and Maximal Self-Evolution
paper.central_claim: A generalist agent with minimal predefined tools plus self-generated, reusable MCPs (found from open-source code, built and run in isolated environments) achieves top-ranking GAIA validation accuracy (75.15% pass@1, 87.27% pass@3), outperforming more complex hand-engineered agents, and its generated MCPs are reusable by other/smaller agents.

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: complete pinned text read end-to-end (abstract, all sections, tables, appendices) before opening seat records; targeted re-reads for every disputed field

evidence.quote: Upon successful tool generation and accurate result formulation, the corresponding script is transformed into an MCP and stored in the internal tool registry for future reuse.
evidence.support_explanation: 明确生成脚本被转换并持久化为可复用 MCP。

evidence.quote: validates the functionality of the generated script by executing it within an isolated environment. If the execution produces the expected results, the tool is registered in the system as a reusable MCP.
evidence.support_explanation: 执行反馈门控入库；expected results 的系统化语义判据未给出。

evidence.quote: This process also supports iterative refinement, allowing for error inspection and subsequent code regeneration to improve the script’s performance.
evidence.support_explanation: 执行错误驱动重新生成，不只是一次性回答自我修辞。

evidence.quote: If these recovery attempts are unsuccessful, the tool is discarded, and the failure is logged for offline analysis and future investigation.
evidence.support_explanation: 设置失败有重试/丢弃与日志，但未报告已有库版本、回滚、权限安全测试。

evidence.quote: Alita with Claude-Sonnet-4 and GPT-4o achieves 75.15% pass@1 and 87.27% pass@3 accuracy
evidence.support_explanation: 作者系统任务准确率，不能用 pass@3 证明可部署选择器。

evidence.quote: The pass@1, pass@2, and pass@3 denote the accuracy achieved by running the Alita framework 1, 2, and 3 times, respectively, and selecting the best answer.
evidence.support_explanation: best answer 选择权限未说明；多次机会与正确答案选择属于 holdout/主张范围，不重复扣统计或测量。

evidence.quote: We collect the MCPs generated from running the GAIA dataset using Alita in conjunction with powerful models (Claude-3.7-Sonnet and GPT-4o).
evidence.support_explanation: 同一 GAIA 来源生成库，再在 GAIA 评测；未写明 disjoint source/evaluation task IDs。

evidence.support_explanation: 小模型同框架加库提高7.27pp；创建成本不在比较中，库来自被评测 GAIA。

evidence.quote: Due to limitations in resources, we randomly selected 100 samples from the dataset.
evidence.support_explanation: MathVista/PathVQA各100样本有分母；未见区间、显著性或独立搜索种子方差。

evidence.quote: Alita highly relies on the coding capability of LLM. When the LLM’s coding capability is really poor, our method will perform worse than traditional generalist agent.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者明确负面边界；Table4小模型43.64对72.73，强 backbone 仍是主要替代解释之一。

evidence.quote: Alita’s development is largely based on the framework of Open Deep Research-smolagents. However, we remove many pre-defined tools and also add the MCP creation component
evidence.support_explanation: 直接方法谱系：删预定义工具，增加按需创建组件；不声称创造动态工具范式。

evidence.quote: All runtime environments are initialized locally in parallel, obviating the need for administrative privileges or containerization technologies.
evidence.support_explanation: Conda依赖隔离而不是经过验证的安全沙箱，不把本地无容器执行当权限隔离保证。

evidence.quote: Leveraging the Python code and the established environment, the Manager Agent successfully packaged the YouTube Video Subtitle Crawler MCP. Subsequently, this MCP was employed
evidence.support_explanation: 同任务成功打包调用案例，非之后独立任务复用证明。

evidence.quote: files or code snippets from GitHub to guide the script generation process.
evidence.support_explanation: 外部代码/文档为生成提供 grounding；本文未给强可复现的所有构建提示与完整库快照。

evidence.quote: most of the current general-purpose agents heavily rely on large-scale manual engineering, including tediously designed workflows, considerable pre-defined tools, and hardcoded components
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap：通用代理依赖手工预定义的工具与工作流。

evidence.quote: It is impractical, if not impossible, to predefine all the tools required for the wide variety of real-world tasks an agent might encounter
evidence.support_explanation: 三点局限（覆盖不全/创造性受限/接口不匹配）为论断式，没有量化诊断（如预定义工具集的缺口统计）。

evidence.quote: Upon successful tool generation and accurate result formulation, the corresponding script is transformed into an MCP and stored in the internal tool registry for future reuse.
evidence.support_explanation: 留存规则：成功生成且结果被判为准确后，脚本封装为 MCP 存入内部注册表（MCP Box）。

evidence.quote: validates the functionality of the generated script by executing it within an isolated environment. If the execution produces the expected results, the tool is registered in the system as a reusable MCP.
evidence.support_explanation: 准入门控为 '执行得到预期结果'；'预期' 由谁/何信号界定未说明，是否使用真值也未说明。

evidence.quote: If these recovery attempts are unsuccessful, the tool is discarded, and the failure is logged for offline analysis and future investigation.
evidence.support_explanation: 失败处理：环境初始化失败尝试放宽版本约束等回退，仍失败则丢弃并离线记录；无失败统计。

evidence.quote: The pass@1, pass@2, and pass@3 denote the accuracy achieved by running the Alita framework 1, 2, and 3 times, respectively, and selecting the best answer.
evidence.support_explanation: pass@k 为多次运行取最佳答案（使用真值的 oracle 选择）；与基线（单次榜单数字）不同口径。

evidence.quote: We run three rounds of testing on GAIA and achieved the best performance on the GAIA leaderboard, surpassing other agent systems.
evidence.support_explanation: pass@1 究竟是哪一轮/均值未说明；三轮结果的分布与方差未给。

evidence.quote: Alita’s development is largely based on the framework of Open Deep Research-smolagents. However, we remove many pre-defined tools and also add the MCP creation component
evidence.support_explanation: 最近的同骨架对照（ODR-smolagents）存在，但 Table 1 中 ODR 的骨干模型未说明，而 Alita 使用 Claude-3.7/Sonnet-4+GPT-4o。

evidence.quote: Alita outperforms all baseline agents across the GAIA levels, achieving the highest total accuracy.
evidence.support_explanation: 读表：Level 1 上 A-World 86.79、OWL 84.91 高于 Alita pass@1（81.13/77.36）；Level 2 Alita 75.58/76.74 > A-World 69.77；Level 3 Alita 46.15/65.38 > OWL 42.31；总计 Alita 72.73/75.15 > OWL 69.09、OpenAI-DR 67.36。'across all levels' 与 Level 1 数字不符，除非以 pass@3 对基线单次比较。

evidence.quote: We collect the MCPs generated from running the GAIA dataset using Alita in conjunction with powerful models (Claude-3.7-Sonnet and GPT-4o).
evidence.support_explanation: 被复用的 MCP 来自 GAIA 数据集本身。

evidence.quote: since Alita, instead of human developers, designs a set of useful MCPs fit to GAIA by trial and error.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者自述 MCP '适配 GAIA'；复用实验在同一 GAIA 验证集上评测，选择集即报告集。

evidence.quote: The reuse of Alita-generated MCPs can enhance the performance of other agents.
we observe a particularly dramatic improvement with the accuracy tripling from 3.85 % to 11.54 %.
the agent doesn’t have distilled MCPs - the agent on GPT-4o-mini model must generate its own MCPs.
evidence.support_explanation: Table 4：Alita(GPT-4o-mini) 总计 43.64%（≈72/165）对比 Table 3 基础框架(GPT-4o-mini，无 Alita MCP，含部分预定义工具)21.82%；同模型对照，但差异同时含 MCP 创建、预定义工具移除与 Web Agent 等。

evidence.quote: Due to limitations in resources, we randomly selected 100 samples from the dataset.
evidence.support_explanation: Mathvista、PathVQA 各仅随机 100 题；采样种子/重复未说明；无方差。

evidence.quote: Alita highly relies on the coding capability of LLM. When the LLM’s coding capability is really poor, our method will perform worse than traditional generalist agent.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认的边界；与 Table 4 一致（GPT-4o-mini 下 43.64% 对比强模型 72.73%）。

evidence.quote: We designed specialized prompts to facilitate accurate self-assessment of the agent’s capabilities.
evidence.support_explanation: MCP Brainstorming 的提示未在文中披露；缺口检测的准确性无评测。

evidence.quote: It consists of 466 real-world scenario-based questions covering daily tasks, scientific reasoning, web browsing, and tool usage.
evidence.support_explanation: 报告的是验证集结果；按 Table 1 百分比反推验证集约 165 题（L1 53/L2 86/L3 26，我们的推断），公开含答案，MCP 生成与复用均在其上。

evidence.quote: Upon retrieving or generating a candidate tool, the system activates the environment planner module.
evidence.support_explanation: 候选工具经环境规划器解析 README/requirements 并在独立 Conda 环境中安装；依赖外部仓库质量。

evidence.quote: The integration of a smaller model significantly reduces the performance.
evidence.support_explanation: 骨干模型能力主导结果，增益归因于 '极简设计' 需要同骨干对照而非跨模型比较。

evidence.quote: Alita, a generalist agent built with a single core capability (i.e., the web agent) and a small set of general-purpose modules that enable self-directed capability expansion.
evidence.support_explanation: '极简' 仍含 Web Agent、Google/GitHub 搜索、浏览器、脚本生成、代码运行、环境管理等预定义组件。

evidence.quote: In comparison, Alita enables MCP creation, which provides additional benefits, including better reusability and easy environment management over tool creation.
evidence.support_explanation: 相对 CRAFT/TroVE/CREATOR/AutoAgent 的差异仅为断言，无 MCP 封装对比普通工具封装的实验。

evidence.quote: We achieve 75.15% pass@1 and 87.27% pass@3, surpassing OpenAI’s Deep Research with 67.36% pass@1 and ranking top among all general-purpose agents.
evidence.support_explanation: 主张是 pass@1 对 pass@1 的比较，Table 1 支持总计层面，但不同模型、不同 harness 混杂。

evidence.quote: on GAIA with and without Alita-generated MCPs based on GPT-4o.
evidence.support_explanation: The MCP reuse experiment is evaluated on GAIA, the same dataset from whose runs the MCPs were collected (§5.1.1); no source/test separation or overlap audit is described.

evidence.quote: Due to limitations in resources, we randomly selected 100 samples from the dataset.
evidence.support_explanation: MathVista/PathVQA are random 100-item slices with no reported tuning on them — the only evaluations not tied to the GAIA library-building runs.

signatures.failure_boundary: 弱编码模型下更差；工具失效/过期/冲突的处理未述；无检索与排序机制说明

gap.author_gap: 通用代理依赖手工预定义工具/工作流：覆盖不全、创造性受限、接口不匹配。
gap.checked_gap: 被改变的对象明确（预定义工具集 → 运行时生成并留存的 MCP）；但三条局限是论断式列举，未量化 '预定义工具不够' 的失败实例或覆盖率，也未论证 MCP 比普通工具封装更优。
gap.lineage_closest_adjacent: 最近邻：CRAFT、TroVE、CREATOR、AutoAgent、OpenHands、AFlow（均在 Sec 2 引用）；技能库先驱（如 Voyager、LATM 类）未引用（背景知识，未在固定材料中核实）。直接骨架：Open Deep Research-smolagents。
gap.residue: MCP 创建依赖强编码模型；复用在同一基准上评测；缺少无 MCP 创建的同骨干消融。
gap.stakes: 若工具生成不可靠，门控不严会把错误脚本固化到注册表并扩散给其他代理。
gap.method_response: 按需检索开源代码并生成/验证/封装为 MCP，形成留存的工具注册表。
gap.remaining_gap: 未证明 '极简预定义' 本身有益；未隔离 MCP 创建对 GAIA 提升的贡献；无留出任务的复用。
gap.unresolved: Voyager/LATM 等邻居原文不在材料中；是否在 Table 1 中使用相同骨干的 ODR 数字未说明。

matches.tactic_steps_checked: C25 step1 责任边界：manager 将检索交给 Web Agent、将精确计算交给生成并执行的脚本——执行；step2 机器可检查的中间产物：可执行脚本/MCP，由运行结果检验——执行；step3 用执行结果闭环并在构建中修正——执行（回溯+环境回退）；step4 消融验证反馈步骤是 load-bearing——缺失；step5 披露委托成本——缺失。
matches.success_failure_checks: 成功：by-products 沉淀为可复用库（met，但无验证库质量的实验）；可获得信号闭环（met）。失败：无消融隔离（触发）；无成本（触发）；仅单基准且工具 '适配 GAIA'（部分触发）。
matches.reason: 该系统的操作是任务拆分→委托给 Web Agent/外部仓库脚本，以可执行产物为接口并回收为库；与 C25 的 '把中间产物变成可机器检查并沉淀为资本' 相符。与同父无其他兄弟卡，故子卡为单例。

rs_pattern.reason: Both seats decompose_and_delegate / C25: the manager emits executable tool scripts as the structured, machine-checkable intermediate artifact, routes them to an interpreter in an isolated environment and closes the loop with execution results (repair, register). Execution success is not task correctness (sol).
rs_pattern.resolves_problem: partial — 在 GAIA 验证集上报告了高精度；但对 '预定义工具不足' 的解决只在选择集上展示，且未隔离 MCP 创建的作用。

matches.condition_checks: H07 步骤：缺口检测显式(met)；外部仓库/README 落地生成(met)；沙箱运行+回溯修复(met)；注册带描述与用例(partial：未述描述/检索)；在非来源任务上评测复用并消融库(unmet：复用评测在 GAIA 源基准上，仅有 store-on/off 两行)。crystallize S1 门控为执行(partial)；S2 能力增量(unmet)；S3 抽象在新输入验证(unmet)；S4 可获得信号修复(met)；S5 保留库带来收益(partial)；S6 外部落地(met)；F1 工件埋在更大架构(部分触发)。

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: C25 的 '可机器检查的中间产物+执行反馈闭环+沉淀为库' 对应 H07 的 '运行中发现缺口→生成并验证可执行工具→注册复用'。
pattern_mapping.required_conditions_and_differences: C25 要求消融验证步骤与成本披露；H07 要求在非来源任务上评测复用并做保留库消融。Alita 两者均仅部分满足（store-on/off 在同一 GAIA 集）。

claims.text: Alita 在 GAIA 验证集达到 75.15% pass@1、87.27% pass@3，居通用代理榜首，超过更复杂的手工系统。
claims.setting: Claude-Sonnet-4+GPT-4o（及 Claude-3.7+GPT-4o）；GAIA 验证集；三轮
claims.baseline_control: Octotools、ODR-smolagents、AutoAgent、OWL、A-World、OpenAI-DR（数字取自榜单/各自报告，骨干模型不一）
claims.selection_vs_test: GAIA 验证集既是 MCP 生成集又是报告集
claims.result_denominator: Table 1；pass@k 取最佳；L1 上多项基线高于 Alita pass@1
claims.allowed_conclusion: 作者报告 Alita(强模型) 总体 pass@1 高于所列基线；Level 1 低于 A-World/OWL；不同骨干与 oracle pass@k 使 '极简设计优于复杂设计' 无法结论。

claims.text: Alita 生成的 MCP 可被其他代理和小模型复用并显著提升性能。
claims.selection_vs_test: MCP 由 GAIA 验证集运行产生，复用评测也在 GAIA 验证集
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在 GAIA 验证集上、用同一数据集生成的 MCP，可给 ODR-smolagents 带来约 +6~+7 点的作者报告提升；不能说明对新任务的泛化。

claims.text: 极简预定义 + 最大自进化比重型手工工具更可扩展。
claims.baseline_control: 未做 '同骨干、预定义工具 vs 自生成工具' 对照

assessment.evidence_level_note: The retained MCP library is collected from GAIA runs and its reuse is evaluated on GAIA (opus:O01); with no source/test separation the library on/off gains are selection-set results (EVIDENCE rule 2). Both seats.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported: Alita with Claude-Sonnet-4/3.7 + GPT-4o reaches 75.15/72.73 pass@1 on GAIA validation (pass@3 is best-of-three with ground-truth selection), and MCPs harvested from GAIA runs raise ODR-smolagents by about 6–7 points on the same GAIA set. Neither the contribution of MCP creation within Alita nor retained-library benefit on unseen tasks is shown; no cost is reported. Not reproduced.

G.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. The object (predefined tool set → runtime-generated retained MCPs) is concrete and tool-creation neighbours (CRAFT, TroVE, CREATOR, AutoAgent, OpenHands) are cited, but the three limitations are asserted rather than measured and the claimed MCP advantage over plain tool creation ('better reusability') has no evidence.

M.reason: Opus sides with son55. Gap self-assessment → web/GitHub grounding → script + env generation → isolated execution → register is reconstructable and answers 'long-tail tool coverage'. But the load-bearing assumptions are untested — the 'expected results' gate certifies correctness, Brainstorming's self-assessment is accurate, and minimal predefinition helps — and no prediction separates it from a code-writing agent without MCP packaging (sol's own reason: distinguishing predictions weak).

X.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Tools, environment management and fallback/discard are specific; the admission signal ('expected results' / 'accurate result formulation') is undefined, registry retrieval/ranking/versioning/retirement are not described, prompts are not disclosed and pass@1's run is unspecified.

E.measurement.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked (reason re-based per A2). GAIA exact-match scoring is credible, but baseline numbers come from heterogeneous leaderboard configurations, the text's 'outperforms all baseline agents across the GAIA levels' is contradicted at Level 1 (A-World 86.79, OWL 84.91 > 81.13), and MathVista/PathVQA scoring is unspecified. The oracle pass@k selection is scored under E.holdout only (correction to son55's reason).

E.causality.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Library on/off within one framework (ODR-smolagents GPT-4o; base framework GPT-4o-mini) supports a local library effect, but Alita itself has no MCP-creation on/off, removal of predefined tools is confounded with the new component, and the main table compares across backbones and harnesses.

E.holdout.reason: Opus sides with son55. Not 0: part of the central claim has applicable evidence — pass@1 on GAIA and random 100-item MathVista/PathVQA slices with no reported tuning (opus:O02). But the retained-library claim has no separation at all: MCPs are harvested from GAIA runs and reused on GAIA (opus:O01; the case-study MCP is question-specific), GAIA validation answers are public, and pass@3 selects the best answer with ground truth (A2: oracle → E.holdout). sol's 0 reads the claim as the library claim only.

E.statistics.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked. Item counts and a negative result (GPT-4o-mini 43.64) are reported; no per-run spread of the three GAIA rounds, no intervals; Level 3 has 26 items and a 2-item change is called 'tripling'. A2 rung 1.

E.cost.reason: Both seats not_reported; re-checked: 'cost', 'token', 'latency', 'budget' do not occur in the pinned text; the only cost statement is the unquantified 'easier, cheaper, and faster' than distillation.
